assets.title: 运矿长廊
assets.composition: Eye-level symmetrical one-point perspective along a monumental underground ore-haulage hall. Two rusty narrow-gauge tracks enter from the lower corners and converge toward a quiet misty far arch just above center. Large timber support frames rhythmically recede along both sides, with idle ore carts confined to the lower outer corners. Broad cohesive slate ceiling, no sky, restrained warm miner lamps along side walls. A spacious, clear middle distance.

assets.title: 深井俯瞰
assets.composition: Dramatic steep high-angle view down into an immense circular mine shaft, NOT a corridor. The viewer stands on a peripheral ledge; weathered wood-and-iron gantries ring the oval pit and a suspended hoist cage hangs near the upper right third. Deep blue-gray void and gentle mist occupy the central middle band; layered ledges and ropes create vertical depth around its edges. Small amber lamps emphasize the spiral industrial structure.

assets.title: 断桥深壑
assets.composition: Very wide side-on panoramic view across a cavern chasm. A narrow old mine railway bridge makes a strong diagonal from lower left to upper right across the view, partially collapsed near the far right, with distant stone buttresses disappearing into haze. Dark rock overhang frames the top; uncluttered cool misty void dominates the center; three small warm lamps on bridge remnants. The bridge is peripheral to the central title-safe region, not centered head-on.

assets.title: 积水泵房
assets.composition: Low water-level camera inside a broad abandoned underground pump chamber. Still dark water covers the lower half, softly reflecting a gigantic rusted pump wheel on the left third, heavy worn-brass pipes running across the ceiling, and a stone stairway rising at the far right. Asymmetrical left-weighted composition, cavern wall recedes into quiet gray mist at center. Warm lantern reflections are sparse; no bright light at image center.

assets.title: 层叠采场
assets.composition: Elevated three-quarter wide establishing shot of a huge subterranean terraced quarry. Excavated rock terraces and timber ramps form broad zigzag strata across the scene, descending from upper left to lower right, with a small derelict haulage shed at lower right. Readable grand excavated architecture, not an outdoor mountain landscape. Central terraces stay broad, quiet and low contrast; small amber work lamps, bluish depth between rock layers.

assets.title: 矿脉侧室
assets.composition: Ground-level oblique view into a wide natural mine cavern with a huge exposed muted quartz and copper mineral vein dominating the RIGHT third, rough timber scaffolds on the left edge and a curving disused rail line across the foreground. Soft teal-gray mineral highlights with tiny warm lamps; the broad center is open cavern floor and atmospheric shadow. Large faceted stone formations rather than a crowded forest of fantasy crystals; subdued mineral glow only, no neon.

assets.title: 熔炉遗址
assets.composition: Broad frontal panorama of an abandoned subterranean ore smelting works. Three squat monumental cold furnaces sit across the background, a tall chimney disappears into the cavern roof at left, and a large broken ore chute sweeps from the upper right into the foreground edge. Faint dying orange embers glow only in the distant left furnace. Broad calm central stone apron, massive architecture at sides, no brightly lit central doorway. Heavy believable worn iron and masonry, melancholy and still.

assets.title: 绞盘机厅
assets.composition: Close-to-mid wide composition through the edge of a monumental iron winding drum in the LEFT foreground, looking obliquely across an old underground hoist engine room toward a small elevated windowless control platform at the RIGHT. Thick cables and diagonal overhead timber beams frame an open low-contrast central floor. Large cropped machine silhouettes provide depth and dramatic asymmetry; rusty iron, weathered wood, tarnished brass, cool ambient light and restrained amber lanterns. No modern screens.

assets.title: 暗河矿港
assets.composition: Expansive wide underground river port viewed from a stone quay. A slow dark river forms a gentle S-curve from the lower left into the far upper right; an empty flat ore barge and decayed timber dock occupy the lower RIGHT edge, huge cave columns rise on the far LEFT. Quay stairs and crane silhouettes only at the edges. Quiet silver-blue reflected light in the middle, a few dim amber mooring lanterns, cavern roof clearly visible, no outdoor sky.

assets.title: 坍塌主井
assets.composition: Low-angle view from beneath a broken heavy timber support arch framing the foreground on both left and right. Beyond is a vast collapsed mine hall: a mound of broad fallen stone slabs lies at lower right, bent railway track curls toward the left, and a huge tilted mining wheel rests against the distant left wall. A single narrow pale shaft of light from a ceiling crack strikes the upper right rock face; central hazy space remains subdued. Strong arch-shaped frame and asymmetric rock mass, entirely underground, no people.
